verdict.rationale: Linear documents that its public GraphQL API is the same API it uses internally to build its own applications, which is a direct UI-parity claim. Schema introspection, a typed SDK, and a community report of driving CI workflows through the GraphQL API reinforce it. missing for 10: an explicit feature-by-feature parity statement or hands-on verification that newer UI features (Linear Agent coding sessions, Loops, Diffs review) are reachable through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.
its GraphQL API and webhooks keep them happy
